title: Nedebang language
extract: Nedebang is a Papuan language spoken in the villages of Balungada and Baulang in the eastern district of Pantar Island in the Alor Archipelago of Indonesia. There are also Nedebang speakers in Air Panas, administratively part of Balungada but located 1 km from the main village.
